name: Speed the Season's Passing (Thaumaturgy (The Green Path), Basic)

system.description: With a touch, you accelerate a plant's growth or decay-causing a seed to bloom or a tree to sprout overnight, or causing grass to wither and stakes to crumble to dust. Spending a Willpower Trait makes the effect nearly instantaneous, including crumbling a stake or wooden weapon in combat. This power cannot be used if you have already been staked.
